headline: Tree House Education & Accessories Limited: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Tree House Education & Accessories Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE under the SEBI Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011, signalling a material acquisition event or change in control triggering mandatory open-market disclosure obligations.
detail: Tree House Education & Accessories Limited, a listed player in educational toys and accessories, has made a Regulation 31(4) filing with NSE. This disclosure is triggered when an acquirer crosses the 25% threshold in share capital or announces a formal takeover bid. The filing initiates the mandatory public disclosure regime under SEBI Takeover Regulations, requiring the acquirer to open a formal offer to all equity shareholders within a specified timeline. As of this disclosure date (30 Jun 2026), the transaction is in the regulatory review and offer-period phase; final completion will depend on shareholder approval and regulatory clearance.
